body:
## What's Changed

### Security fixes

This release fixes seven vulnerabilities. See [Security advisories: multiple vulnerabilities in Regexp and String case conversion](https://www.ruby-lang.org/en/news/2026/11/18/multiple-vulnerabilities-in-regexp-and-string/) for details.

* [GHSA-34m4-m9fh-gqp5](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/security/advisories/GHSA-34m4-m9fh-gqp5): Heap buffer overflow in case conversion of strings ([#20005](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/20005))
* [GHSA-7x2q-68qv-6p8x](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/security/advisories/GHSA-7x2q-68qv-6p8x): Double free in regular expression compilation ([#20001](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/20001))
* [GHSA-87fm-7w84-j2px](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/security/advisories/GHSA-87fm-7w84-j2px): Integer overflow in case conversion of strings ([#20006](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/20006))
* [GHSA-wpqw-5qxg-m68r](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/security/advisories/GHSA-wpqw-5qxg-m68r): Out-of-bounds read in case-insensitive regular expression matching ([#20002](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/20002))
* [GHSA-3p8q-wmhx-vm2w](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/security/advisories/GHSA-3p8q-wmhx-vm2w): Heap buffer overflow in regular expression compilation ([#20000](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/20000))
* [GHSA-7whj-cfh7-xgm4](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/security/advisories/GHSA-7whj-cfh7-xgm4): Heap buffer overflow in Regexp#to_s ([#20004](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/20004))
* [GHSA-pvgc-g7gj-pv6h](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/security/advisories/GHSA-pvgc-g7gj-pv6h): Out-of-bounds read in case-insensitive backreference matching ([#20003](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/20003))

### String and encodings

* IO#write of a shareable String from multiple Ractors causes use-after-free ([Bug #22382](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22382), [#19023](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19023))
* String#initialize(encoding:) stores an inflated capacity and writes past the malloc'd buffer on append (rb_str_init termlen double-adjust) ([Bug #22423](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22423), [#19297](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19297), [#19403](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19403))
* Coderange may be set incorrectly when concatenating a string into itself ([Bug #22451](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22451), [#19357](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19357))
* Use-after-free in `String` formatting with wide character encodings ([Bug #22461](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22461), [#19472](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19472))
* UTF-32 strings with a byte 0x80 or more in the most significant position are reported as valid ([Bug #22495](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22495), [#19646](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19646))
* Some String methods return a UTF-16/32 string without room for its terminator ([Bug #22517](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22517), [#19794](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19794))
* String#unpack("m") computes the buffer size with an overflowing multiplication ([Bug #22518](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22518), [#19797](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19797))
* Fix an out-of-bounds write in substrings of UTF-16/UTF-32 strings and an over-read when marking temporary buffers; only these two memory fixes are taken from “gc.c: Verify provided size in `rb_gc_impl_free`” by byroot ([#15989](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/15989))
* Copy terminator when moving strings to the heap. by eightbitraptor ([#16201](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/16201))
* Packing the buffer into itself is not possible by nobu ([#16741](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/16741))
* sprintf.c: Fix width overflow by nobu ([#17221](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/17221))
* Use the result encoding for the terminator in String#ljust/rjust/center by mame ([#17260](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/17260))
* Fix a potential out-of-bounds read by nobu ([#17754](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/17754))
* Keep the fallback string alive across rb_econv_insert_output by ko1 ([#18569](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18569))
* Fix out-of-range reads and negative-length substrings in String by hsbt ([#18658](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18658))
* Fix understated max_output in three transcoders by hsbt ([#18661](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18661))
* Fix out-of-bounds in String#setbyte when string modified by peterzhu2118 ([#18878](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18878))
* Fix use-after-free in String#[]= when string modified by peterzhu2118 ([#18898](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18898))
* Fix buffer overflow in String#slice! when string modified by peterzhu2118 ([#18906](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18906))
* Fix use-after-free in String#strip methods by peterzhu2118 ([#18920](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18920))
* Fix use-after-free in String#each_line with separator modified by peterzhu2118 ([#18925](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18925))
* Fix use-after-free in String#% when array modified by peterzhu2118 ([#18931](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18931))
* Fix out-of-bounds access in String#byteindex/byterindex by peterzhu2118 ([#18942](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18942))
* Fix buffer overflow in String#rpartition by peterzhu2118 ([#18946](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18946))
* Fix use-after-free in String#unpack by peterzhu2118 ([#18970](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18970))
* Fix crash in Array#pack when format string modified by peterzhu2118 ([#19011](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19011))
* Fix overflow checks that rely on negating LONG_MIN and INT_MIN by hsbt ([#19207](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19207))
* Fix integer overflow in String#[]= with a capture index of INT_MIN by mame ([#19504](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19504))
* Check the terminator length in rb_str_resize and rb_str_modify_expand by mame ([#19697](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19697))
* Check the size before growing the output buffer of transcoding by mame ([#19798](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19798))
* Fix use-after-free when string modified in warning by peterzhu2118 ([#19904](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19904))
* Fix buffer overflow in chilled string warning in String#setbyte by peterzhu2118 ([#19913](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19913))
* Fix out-of-bounds for modified chilled string in String#append_as_bytes by peterzhu2118 ([#19914](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19914))
* Disallow converting a buffer into itself in primitive_convert by afsozer ([#19918](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19918))
* Fix overlapping memcpy in String#<< when chilled string modified by peterzhu2118 ([#19920](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19920))

### Regexp

* The number of captures may change depending on the encoding of the target string ([Bug #22491](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22491), [#19641](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19641), [#19799](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19799))
* String#rindex misses a match with a leading .* in multiline mode ([Bug #22492](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22492), [#19643](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19643))
* Regexp search misses a match when an assertion precedes a leading .* ([Bug #22494](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22494), [#19645](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19645))
* Part of “Update Onigmo to 6.2.0” by nobu ([#15851](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/15851)):
  * [k-takata/Onigmo] Fix out-of-bounds read in parse_char_class()
  * Now onigenc_single_byte_code_to_mbclen checks out-of-bound
  * [k-takata/Onigmo] Fix that onig_new() may crash
  * [k-takata/Onigmo] Fix SEGV in onig_error_code_to_str()
  * [k-takata/Onigmo] Fix stack overflow with X+++++++++++++++++++…
* Check the result of compile_length_tree() at every call site by mame ([#19505](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19505))
* Check remaining pattern length in str_lower_case_match by mame ([#19560](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19560))
* Check the remaining length in rb_memsearch_qs_utf8_hash by mame ([#19704](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19704))

### Core classes

* Lazy enumerator `.each_with_index` ignores `.take(0)` before it ([Bug #21142](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/21142), [Bug #22496](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22496), [#19109](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19109), [#19668](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19668))
* Assertion Failed: ary_resize_capa:RARRAY_LEN(ary) <= capacity ([Bug #22333](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22333), [#18907](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18907))
* Out-of-bounds in `Array#sample` when array modified ([Bug #22449](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22449), [#19384](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19384))
* `Time#strftime` out-of-bound access ([Bug #22458](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22458), [#19457](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19457))
* Array#find and Array#rfind arity change between versions 3 and 4 ([Bug #22470](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22470), [#19516](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19516))
* Overflow in `st_init_existing_table_with_size` / `Hash.new(capacity:)` ([Bug #22512](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22512), [#19773](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19773))
* Array#fill should respect frozenness from yields ([Bug #22529](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22529), [#19821](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19821))
* Ensure `T_DATA` before `RTYPEDDATA_P` by nobu ([#15758](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/15758))
* Prefer `ALLOCV` over `ALLOCA` for unknown size by nobu ([#15765](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/15765))
* Separate the case `default_seed_bits` is 0 by nobu ([#16341](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/16341))
* enumerator.c: guard `eargs` in `append_method` and `arith_seq_inspect` by dummyx ([#16809](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/16809))
* Add writebarrier for Array#reverse by jhawthorn ([#17944](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/17944))
* Fix bignum power_cache across Ractors (used by big2str/str2big) by luke-gruber ([#18094](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18094))
* Marshal.load: Fix buffer overflow at overread of string body by hsbt ([#18368](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18368))
* Check struct size when a user class relabels a loaded struct by hsbt ([#18657](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18657))
* Fix out-of-bounds in Array#permutation when array modified by peterzhu2118 ([#18951](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18951))
* Fix use-after-free in Time.new when string modified by peterzhu2118 ([#18956](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18956))
* Fix use-after-free in Marshal.dump by peterzhu2118 ([#18974](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18974))
* Fix out-of-bounds crash in Array#repeated_permutation by peterzhu2118 ([#19095](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19095))
* Add a more defensive GC guard in `Set#&` by nobu ([#19166](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19166), follow-up of [Bug #22388](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22388))
* Do not embed arrays that will overflow length bits by peterzhu2118 ([#19193](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19193))
* Do not parse past an empty string in `rb_int_parse_cstr` by fuzzyrichie ([#19656](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19656); the pull request is titled after `MatchData#integer_at`, which does not exist in Ruby 4.0)
* Early return from `ary_sample` if the sampling number is 0 by nobu ([#19673](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19673))
* Fix the digit count of rb_int_parse_cstr for all-zero input by mame ([#19698](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19698))
* Fix UAF in marshall.c by eightbitraptor ([#19733](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19733))
* Check reentry after comparison conversion by nobu ([#19753](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19753))
* Fix signed integer overflow in rb_range_component_beg_len by gotoken ([#19824](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19824))
* Fix TOCTOU in Array#pop when array frozen in to_int by peterzhu2118 ([#19935](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19935))

### IO, File, Process and Socket

* Socket.tcp_with_fast_fallback('example.com', 80, '127.0.0.1') fails with unknown socket domain: ipv4 (SocketError) ([Bug #21512](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/21512), [#19363](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19363))
* `IO#external_encoding` / `IO#internal_encoding` segfault on an uninitialized IO ([Bug #22410](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22410), [#19252](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19252))
* IO#sysread and IO#pread are inconsistent for length 0 and negative numbers; only the check for a negative length with a buffer argument is backported ([Bug #22433](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22433), [#19323](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19323))
* IO#readpartial can raise EFAULT during GC.compact in another thread ([Bug #22467](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22467), [#19515](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19515))
* File.realdirpath returns a wrong path when GC runs while it resolves a relative symlink ([Bug #22479](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22479), [#19573](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19573))
* `IO#gets(nil, limit)` stops right after a 0xFF byte ([Bug #22537](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22537), [#19941](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19941))
* Process.spawn leaves the env, umask, and redirections applied in the parent on Windows when chdir: fails ([Bug #22540](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22540), [#19893](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19893))
* Fix: Do not fast_fallback if local_port is explicitly specified by shioimm ([#15732](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/15732))
* Ensure safe handling of hexdump width. by ioquatix ([#16593](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/16593))
* Fix IO::Buffer#each_byte bounds check by afurm ([#16823](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/16823))
* `rb_fiber_scheduler_blocking_operation_wait` can garbage collect `blocking_operation` incorrectly. by samuel-williams-shopify ([#16908](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/16908))
* Dump FreeBSD socket credential data wholely by nobu ([#17214](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/17214))
* io.c: use a write barrier when storing IO#timeout= by ko1 ([#17670](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/17670))
* Fix connection attempt fd handling in TCPSocket.new fast fallback by hsbt ([#18840](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18840))
* Synchronize fast fallback cleanup with resolver threads by hsbt ([#18844](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18844))
* Fix resolver error handling in `TCPSocket.new` fast fallback by hsbt ([#18846](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18846))
* Keep stdin open when TCPSocket.new rejects open_timeout by hsbt ([#19523](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19523))
* Fix fill_cbuf putting back more bytes than the current rbuf fill holds by mame ([#19565](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19565))
* Lock the buffer in IO.copy_stream fallback reads by rhenium ([#19618](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19618))
* Skip whitespace in rb_memory_view_parse_item_format fill pass by fuzzyrichie ([#19807](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19807))
* Fix thread leaks in `Socket.tcp_with_fast_fallback` by nobu ([c091c186e4](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/commit/c091c186e425b659f7aa88ffeac20a41a27b0582), backported in [#19810](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19810))

### VM, GC, Thread and Ractor

* `Thread#raise` and `Fiber#raise` can set VM throw data as `Exception#cause`, causing a crash. ([Bug #22541](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22541), [Bug #19593](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/19593), [#19861](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19861))
* ruby-prof breaks on 4.0.1 ([Bug #21854](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/21854), [#16002](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/16002))
* ruby-head builds have been failing on aarch64-linux CI in ruby/ruby-dev-builder ([Bug #22261](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22261), [#18495](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18495))
* Hang on GC.compact ([Bug #22389](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22389), [#19118](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19118))
* ASan UAF and Assertion Failed: gc_validate_pc:CFP_PC(cfp) >= iseq_encoded: PC not set when allocating, breaking tracing ([Bug #22409](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22409), [#19250](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19250))
* Assertion Failed: vm_ep_in_heap_p_:env->ep == ep ([Bug #22412](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22412), [#19251](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19251))
* Array#zip with a method_missing-based argument leaks a stale block handler (segfault when the next C-called method yields) ([Bug #22436](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22436), [#19337](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19337))
* Thread#name= on a terminated thread may dump core ([Bug #22471](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22471), [#19520](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19520))
* rb_profile_frames() called from a signal handler segfaults while vm_make_env_each() is escaping a chain of frames ([Bug #22476](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22476), [#19559](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19559))
* rb_ec_clear_vm_stack() can still clear the VM stack before ec->cfp = NULL on aarch64 ([Bug #22477](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22477), [#19561](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19561))
* Proc#== does not return true for the same lexical code block ([Bug #22498](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22498), [#19696](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19696))
* Keyword arguments can be freed during argument setup when a method has more than 31 keywords ([Bug #22500](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22500), [#19679](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19679))
* Empty keyword hash mishandled when calling a Method proc through the C API ([Bug #22504](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22504), [#19607](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/19607))
